title: Reject an exact Markov or sector-independent reduction at finite dephasing
statement: The exact charged two-level reduction has zprime=-4epsilon² integral exp[-gamma(t-s)]cos[Delta(t-s)]z(s)ds and zprime(0)=0. Finite gamma does not give a nonzero constant-rate classical two-state semigroup. For joint CSS detuning Delta=sX+sZ, populations depend on the other sector; adding nominal thermal recovery also changes its stationary polarization under charged drive.

requires: Accepted source-qualified even RX/RZ family and nominal H0=sum(I-S_j)/2, exact shared corrected logical algebra, fixed geometry/incidence and beta>beta_c
provides: Accepted local admission counterexamples to free Markov/sector/Gibbs reductions
assumptions: Not a many-body-memory failure theorem or an exclusion of every larger hidden-state classical realization
Finite-order low-frequency/Zeno rates do not close an exponentially long storage interval
Random sign changes or Pauli-times-full-syndrome Kraus form do not establish sector-own-algebra transition rates
The unresolved task is nonequilibrium decoder-bad space-time control for charged errors; no impossibility or sign-problem hardness follows
costs: Jstar=2 nu v0+6+2 J_e, support Q and3n per-seed controller budget; energy H0/dephasing defects vanish exactly
Exact nominal syndrome sampler at beta=ln B has expected proposals<=(1+1/B)^m<=exp(m/B); no efficient-in-n promise
Qualified preparation/control/routing/holding/reset/readout, physical rates and full noisy-preparation debit remain additional
contract.units: Exact local population return kernel, finite dephasing/thermal rates and stationary nominal polarization; not a generic bath-memory lifetime.

body: Actual stationary state is rho0=Gibbs(H0), generally NOT Gibbs(H0+V). Unknown Hermitian V must satisfy[H0,V]=0; it may fail individual-check commutation. Dissipative errors must be the declared balanced class, not all weak Lindblad errors. Arbitrary energy-changing errors, native physical controller/bath, useful thresholds, efficient/noisy initialization and advantage remain open. The ordinary Bravyi-Terhal trace receiver and nominal Davies/virtual-subsystem construction are credited. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
